includes: Layout redesign and wall removal (with permits)
Quartz, quartzite and natural stone countertops

faqs.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Palatine?
faqs.a: Most full kitchen remodels we build fall in a wide range set mainly by cabinetry, counters and whether walls or plumbing move. We give you a fixed, itemized written quote after a free in-home visit, so you see every line before anything starts.

faqs.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
faqs.a: Plan on 6 to 10 weeks of on-site work for a full remodel once cabinets are delivered. Custom cabinet lead times can add 4 to 8 weeks before demolition, and we schedule demo around delivery so your kitchen isn't torn out while you wait.

faqs.q: Can we live at home during a kitchen remodel?
faqs.a: Yes, most clients stay home. We seal the work area with dust barriers, protect floors, and can help you set up a temporary kitchen in another room.

faqs.q: Do you pull permits for kitchen remodels?
faqs.a: Yes. We pull the village permits, schedule inspections and meet the inspector on site.

name: Bathroom Remodeling
short: Primary suites, hall baths and powder rooms: curbless showers, freestanding tubs, heated floors, custom vanities and tile.
seoTitle: Bathroom Remodeling in Palatine, IL | RD Group
seoDescription: Bathroom remodels in Palatine and the Northwest Suburbs: walk-in and curbless showers, tub-to-shower conversions, heated floors and custom tile. Free consultation. Call 773-936-9244.
intro: RD Group builds bathroom remodels in Palatine and the Northwest Suburbs, from powder rooms to full primary suites. Most full bathroom remodels take 3 to 5 weeks on site. Every shower we build gets a tested waterproofing system before tile goes on.

faqs.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Palatine?
faqs.a: Cost depends mostly on size, tile selection, and whether plumbing moves. After a free in-home visit we give you a fixed, itemized written quote so there are no surprise line items.

faqs.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faqs.a: Most full bathroom remodels take 3 to 5 weeks on site. A tub-to-shower conversion can take as little as 1 to 2 weeks.

faqs.q: Can you convert my tub into a walk-in shower?
faqs.a: Yes. Tub-to-shower conversions are one of our most common projects, including low-threshold and curbless designs for aging in place.

faqs.q: What waterproofing do you use in showers?
faqs.a: We use sheet or liquid membrane systems from Schluter or Laticrete and flood-test shower pans before tile is installed.

faqs.q: Do you take on smaller projects?
faqs.a: Yes. Flooring, tile, trim and repair work are welcome, especially for past kitchen and bath clients.

faqs.q: How long does it take to finish a basement?
